title: Wkpoule Redis & Cache Observability
description: Companion queries for Redis server metrics (Elastic Redis OTel integration) and application cache metrics exported by wkpoule-api via OTLP.

setup.elastic_integration: Install the Redis OpenTelemetry Assets integration (v0.2.0+) from Kibana → Integrations → Redis OTel. Enable beta integrations if needed.
setup.collector: Apply openshift/base/otel-collector.yaml (redis receiver on metrics/redis pipeline).

recommended_panels.title: Application cache hit rate
recommended_panels.query: FROM metrics-* | WHERE service.name == "wkpoule-api" AND metric.name IN ("wkpoule.cache.hit", "wkpoule.cache.miss") | STATS hits = SUM(CASE(metric.name == "wkpoule.cache.hit", metric.sum, 0)), misses = SUM(CASE(metric.name == "wkpoule.cache.miss", metric.sum, 0)) BY bucket = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp) | EVAL hit_rate = hits / (hits + misses) * 100 | KEEP bucket, hit_rate, hits, misses

recommended_panels.title: Cache operation latency p95 (ms)
recommended_panels.query: FROM metrics-* | WHERE service.name == "wkpoule-api" AND metric.name == "wkpoule.cache.operation.duration" | STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(metric.histogram, 95) BY cache.operation = metric.attributes.cache.operation, bucket = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp)

recommended_panels.title: Redis keyspace hit rate (server)
recommended_panels.query: FROM metrics-* | WHERE service.name == "redis" AND metric.name IN ("redis.keyspace.hits", "redis.keyspace.misses") | STATS hits = SUM(CASE(metric.name == "redis.keyspace.hits", metric.sum, 0)), misses = SUM(CASE(metric.name == "redis.keyspace.misses", metric.sum, 0)) BY bucket = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp) | EVAL hit_rate = hits / (hits + misses) * 100

recommended_panels.title: Redis memory used
recommended_panels.query: FROM metrics-* | WHERE service.name == "redis" AND metric.name == "redis.memory.used" | STATS used_bytes = MAX(metric.gauge) BY bucket = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp)

recommended_panels.title: Redis connection pool (API)
recommended_panels.query: FROM metrics-* | WHERE service.name == "wkpoule-api" AND metric.name == "wkpoule.redis.pool.connections" | STATS connections = MAX(metric.gauge) BY pool.metric = metric.attributes.pool.metric, bucket = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp)

recommended_panels.title: Redis command latency p99 (server)
recommended_panels.query: FROM metrics-* | WHERE service.name == "redis" AND metric.name == "redis.cmd.latency" | STATS p99_us = PERCENTILE(metric.histogram, 99) BY bucket = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp)

alerts.note: Use bundled [Redis OTel] alert rules from the Elastic integration for server-side issues (evictions, maxmemory, rejected connections).
application_suggestions: Cache hit rate below 50% for 15 minutes on wkpoule-api
